verdict.rationale: Moneybird publishes a static API reference that describes endpoints, such as the contacts endpoints, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples (try-it consoles, live request execution). The probe also found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the candidate paths, so there is no machine-readable basis for one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
